description: Here Is What We Offer Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture A successful alumni relations program depends on a robust strategy to build lasting relationships with alumni and ensure their continued engagement and support. The Assistant Director, Alumni Programs, focuses on developing and implementing centralized engagement initiatives and programs to support the alumni community at Howard University. This role is a key driver in fostering a lifelong connection between the University and its alumni population through educational, professional development, and networking opportunities. Supervisory Authority This position will have supervisory authority over the Manager for Career and Professional Development Manager and the Manager for Reunion Programs. The Assistant Director provides leadership, direction, coaching, performance management, and professional development for these positions; establishes annual goals and priorities; and ensures alignment across program portfolios. This role is also responsible for overseeing career development opportunities and reunions. The position is accountable for overseeing the planning and execution of all alumni reunions and reunion staff roles. Additionally, the position works alongside the campus partners like the Office of the Secretary, Center for Career and Professional Success, and the Ralphe Bunche Center. A key responsibility includes developing and disseminating engaging content through various channels, including newsletters, social media, and online communities, to keep alumni informed and connected. The Assistant Director will also track and analyze alumni engagement metrics and use this data to inform future strategies and improve programs. The role also involves collaborating with leadership to identify and recognize alumni contributions through programs and events. This position will support efforts to maintain an up-to-date alumni database and provide reports to university stakeholders as requested. Core Competencies Proven experience in planning and executing large-scale events and multi-channel engagement strategies. Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously and meet deadlines. Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to build and maintain relationships with diverse constituencies. Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities. Proficiency in relevant technologies, including alumni databases (e.g., Raiser's Edge), event management tools, PeopleGrove, and social media. Ability to work comfortably and effectively both independently and in group scenarios. A belief in and ability to articulate the university's mission and the importance of alumni engagement. Three (3) to five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in alumni relations, event management, or a related field. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite. Experience working with various software programs for engagement, including marketing platforms, event platforms, or CRM systems. Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills. Atuar com orientação geral e revisão periódica do trabalho, demonstrando adaptabilidade em contextos sujeitos a alterações imprevisíveis e de complexidade variável. title: Brazil - Rio de Janeiro: Tax Manager
description: We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. Job Duties Lead all tax-related activities in Brazil, including direct and indirect taxes, transfer pricing, and tax reporting required by internal corporate team. Ensure full compliance with federal, state and municipal tax regulations. Develop and implement tax planning strategies to optimize the company’s tax position and mitigate tax risks. Serve as the primary liaison with external auditors, tax consultants, and government authorities. Provide expert tax guidance on contracts, new business initiatives, cross-border transactions supporting domestic activities and business operations to ensure compliance, tax optimization and appropriate risk management. Strong knowledge of tax regulations, audit processes, and financial reporting standards. Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional finance and business teams. Excellent analytical, research, and problem-solving skills related to tax issues and compliance. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic and complex environment. Experience in managing a large team. Solid proficiency in English and Portuguese. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Implement, manage and improve tax compliance strategies adapting to Brazil's dynamic regulatory environment, ensuring alignment with global standards and anticipate regulatory changes. Ensure the accuracy and timeliness of tax calculation and reporting for external and internal compliance requirements such as USGAAP Provision, FIN48, FAS5, Audit reports, cash and ETR tax forecast. Proactive to implement technology and automation solutions. Develop and mentor the local team, fostering a culture of continuous learning, proactive attitude. Champion data-driven decision-making by leveraging analytics to identify compliance trends, optimize tax strategies and manage tax risk effectively. Overseeing all aspects of Brazil Tax Reform, keeping on track with new legal requirement and lead the cross functional team to execute the financial strategy to guarantee Tax Compliance, optimize the future financial impacts and cash flow. title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: A SICPA é uma empresa suíça de tecnologia. Dentro da SICPA, o departamento de Pesquisa e Inovação Digital dimensiona produtos de tecnologia digital de ponta para uso no setor público. Bons conhecimentos de SQL para recuperar e manipular dados de forma eficaz. Sólidos conhecimentos das melhores práticas de engenharia de software e ferramentas de conteinerização (Docker). Sólida compreensão de estatística, algoritmos e estruturas de dados. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, com capacidade de explicar conceitos técnicos tanto para partes interessadas técnicas quanto não técnicas. Habilidades preferenciais: Familiaridade com plataformas em nuvem (AWS, Azure) e MLOps. Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e mentalidade orientada para os detalhes. Capacidade de gerenciar vários projetos simultaneamente. title: Senior Process Optimization (RTO/ROMeo) & Digital Twin (PST) Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabi[...]
description: This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat position with an attractive relocation package. Please note only qualified candidates will be contacted. *** Candidates with Chemical Engineering degree and 17-25 years of experience in Refinery Only*** ***English proficiency (written and spoken) required. Submit CV in English for consideration*** Overview We are seeking an experienced Process Simulation Twin (PST) and Optimization Engineer to join our Reliability Solutions Department (RSD) within our Global Manufacturing Excellence Center. Global Manufacturing Excellence (GME) is the recognized Center of Excellence driving value across Saudi Aramco’s Downstream Global manufacturing portfolio. Your primary role is to deploy and sustain online process simulations (process digital twins), perform process optimization activities to identify opportunities, monitor process performance KPIs and develop advanced process optimization data-enabled solutions. This role sits at the boundary of process engineering and digitalization beyond traditional process simulation roles. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between rigorous thermodynamic models, process digital twins, real-time process data and hybrid analytics through AI. Key Responsibilities As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following: Lead the development, deployment, and sustainment of PST that integrate real-time process data with rigorous equation-oriented or sequential simulation engines in alignment with corporate objectives. Configure and troubleshoot the connectivity between plant historians, laboratory information systems, and simulation software to ensure seamless data ingestion and reconciliation. Utilize PST to perform automated monitoring of facility health, detecting deviations between ideal performance and actual plant operations to identify opportunity gaps. Develop and maintain thermodynamic models and mathematical equations that accurately represent the behavior of various processes ensuring the PST accurately reflects the current state of the facility (including heat exchanger fouling, catalyst decay, etc.). Perform offline engineering studies using PST to analyze complex operational problems, debottleneck constraints, and conduct "what-if" scenarios based on current operating conditions. Act as the technical liaison between data teams and Operations/Process Engineering teams, leading technical sessions on model architecture, data quality, and commissioning. Lead process optimization sessions to de-bottleneck key process units such as CDU/VDU, Hydrocrackers, Catalytic crackers, Diesel Hydrotreaters, Isomerization. Benchmark process optimization KPIs with 15+ operating facilities and provide development of programs, processes, guidelines and best practices. Provide subject matter expertise to operating facilities Operations, Maintenance, and Engineering teams by consulting, providing awareness sessions, and participating and leading technical exchanges and conferences. You must hold a Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering. You will have a minimum of 15 years of experience in Process Simulations, Online Modeling, or Real-Time Optimization (preferably ROMeo). 20 years of experience is preferred. You will be able to Demonstrate expertise in process engineering and flowsheet-based processes simulation. Preferred Equation Oriented simulation. You will have comprehensive understanding of refinery facilities, feedstock/product movements, margins, giveaways, process yields, and mass and energy balances. Demonstrated experience connecting simulations to live data sources (Data Historians, OPC, etc.). Strong understanding of data reconciliation, model tuning, and dealing with gross errors in industrial data is also required. Work Location and Work Schedule Work location: Within Saudi Arabia – To be specified in Job offer Work schedule: Full Time - To be specified in Job offer #J-18808-Ljbffr

Cada projeto tem suas tecnologias, soluções e prazos e você terá oportunidade de atuar e experimentar diferentes desafios. Além da nossa atuação pelo Brasil, com escritório no Rio de janeiro, São Paulo e Belo Horizonte, temos também filiais nos Estados Unidos, fazendo com que a Radix se consolide cada vez mais como uma empresa global . Quer fazer parte dessa história e transformar ideias e sonhos em realidade? Como Profissional de Ciência de Dados você vai: Coletar, limpar e organizar dados de fontes diversas para análises. Desenvolver modelos básicos de machine learning sob a supervisão de cientistas de dados mais experientes. Auxiliar na execução de tarefas como criação de relatórios, geração de insights e visualização de dados. Contribuir na documentação de processos, scripts e análises. Focar no aprimoramento de habilidades técnicas, como a programação em Python, banco de dados e o uso de bibliotecas de ciência de dados como pandas, numpy e scikit-learn. Apoiar na validação de modelos de machine learning. Trabalhar em conjunto com engenheiros de dados e cientistas de dados para compreender melhor o problema de negócios e como a ciência de dados pode ser empregada para a solução dos mesmos. Para essa vaga, você deve ter: Inglês intermediário para conversação. Entender a diferença entre tipos de aprendizagem (supervisionado, não supervisionado etc.), além do básico de estatística descritiva. Entender o que é um dataset e saber o básico sobre análise de dados. Noções de base de dados relacionais e/ou não-relacionais. Conhecimento de Python e de algumas bibliotecas populares de ciência de dados, como pandas, scikit-learn, matplotlib etc. Conhecimento de técnicas de engenharia de prompt para geração de soluções de A.I. generativa sem o emprego de fine tuning de modelos. Conhecimento em algoritmos e estrutura de dados. Habilidades em análise: Capacidade de realizar análises de dados simples, com foco na extração, limpeza e interpretação de dados. Interesse em aprender novas técnicas de machine learning e boas práticas de ciência de dados. Habilidade para trabalhar em conjunto com profissionais mais experientes, absorvendo orientações e feedbacks. É um diferencial se você tiver: Graduação em áreas como Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática, Física, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Cursos de especialização ou de curta duração em Ciência de Dados / Machine Learning. O espírito de equipe é a nossa maior força. Trabalhamos de forma cooperativa e sabemos que estamos juntos, remando na mesma direção. Temos um ambiente diverso, que valoriza equidade e inclusão. Nossa jornada de trabalho é flexível e em quase todos os projetos é possível trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil. Valorizamos o bem-estar e o cuidado com as nossas pessoas, com programas de apoio à saúde mental, psiquiatra e médico consultor disponíveis. Código da vaga : b6a6 Há 16 anos entre as melhores empresas para trabalhar no Rio, no Brasil e em Tecnologia... Prazer, Radix. Atuamos na transformação digital de clientes em diversos segmentos, implementamos soluções que tornam os processos mais eficientes, através de um time altamente especializado e multidisciplinar. Temos presença global, com projetos em mais de 30 países, para empresas de diferentes tamanhos e setores. Nosso time está crescendo. Formamos uma equipe comprometida com resultados e capaz de resolver problemas desafiadores. Venha crescer conosco! Como Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno na PrimeUp você: Atuará em um projeto extensivo de transformação digital e inovação de uma multinacional do segmento de energia; Irá integrar o time de Engenharia de Detecção de Ameaças, atuando na criação, melhoria e sustentação de mecanismos de detecção em ambientes corporativos de segurança; Será responsável por correlacionar eventos de diferentes tecnologias de segurança e infraestrutura, contribuindo diretamente para o aumento da capacidade de detecção, resposta e maturidade da operação de segurança; Principais desafios: Criar, revisar e otimizar casos de uso para detecção de ameaças em soluções de SIEM. Desenvolver regras de correlação com base em eventos provenientes de diferentes fontes de log. Analisar padrões de ataques, técnicas, táticas e procedimentos utilizados por agentes maliciosos. Apoiar a evolução dos mecanismos de detecção com base em frameworks como MITRE ATT&CK, NIST e ISO 27001. Avaliar logs, eventos e alertas de diferentes tecnologias para identificar oportunidades de melhoria na detecção. Apoiar a integração de novas fontes de dados ao SIEM. Realizar tuning de regras, reduzindo falsos positivos e aumentando a efetividade dos alertas. Documentar casos de uso, lógicas de correlação, critérios de acionamento e procedimentos operacionais. Atuar em conjunto com times de SOC, resposta a incidentes, infraestrutura e arquitetura de segurança. Acompanhar tendências de ameaças, vulnerabilidades e técnicas de ataque para propor novas detecções. Para assumir esse desafio você precisa ter conhecimento e/ou experiência: Configuração, administração ou operação de soluções de SIEM; Criação de casos de uso para detecção de ameaças; Desenvolvimento ou manutenção de regras de correlação; Análise de logs e eventos de segurança; Conceitos de anatomia de ataques e ameaças em cybersegurança; Fundamentos sólidos de redes TCP/IP, protocolos, portas, serviços e comunicação entre sistemas; Sistemas operacionais Microsoft Windows Server e Linux Server; Tecnologias de segurança em ambientes corporativos, como firewall, EDR, antivírus, proxy, IAM, VPN, WAF, entre outras; Frameworks e boas práticas de segurança, como MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, CIS Controls e ISO 27001; Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação, Redes, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas; No mínimo 2 anos de experiência em Segurança da Informação; Pelo menos 1 ano de experiência prática com alguma solução de SIEM; Capacidade de interpretar eventos de segurança e transformar análises em melhorias de detecção; Perfil analítico, investigativo e orientado à resolução de problemas; Capacidade de documentação técnica clara e objetiva. Será bacana se você também tiver: Certificações em Segurança da Informação, como: Security+, CySA+, CEH, SSCP, SC-200, AZ-500 ou similares. Conhecimento em IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Elastic Security ou outras soluções de SIEM. Conhecimento em gestão de vulnerabilidades. Experiência com Tenable, Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7 ou ferramentas similares. Familiaridade com inteligência de ameaças e fontes de IOC. Obs.: A vaga é remota para candidatos fora das regiões metropolitanas de RJ e SP. Para residentes nas regiões metropolitanas de RJ e SP, o modelo é híbrido (1 vez por semana presencial). Na Light, buscamos um Coordenador(a) de Base de Remuneração que será responsável por liderar as atividades de gestão patrimonial e ativo imobilizado, garantindo conformidade regulatória, controle dos ativos e suporte estratégico às decisões do negócio. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia! Traga a sua energia para a Light! Prestar suporte as áreas responsáveis pela construção dos ativos (quer construindo ou adquirindo), com a aplicação das legislações vigentes, para a correta aplicação dos custos de formação dos bens; Manter/atender as políticas definidas pela ANEEL pertinentes aos temas do ativo imobilizado e base de remuneração; Assegurar o processo de conciliação físico entre o sistema georefenciado e o ativo imobilizado na unitização da obra; Participar com efetividade das discussões sobre controle patrimonial nos diversos fóruns que tratam do assunto (ANEEL, ABRACONEE, entre outros), visando formar uma visão de conjunto para influir positivamente na justa avaliação dos controles patrimoniais; Garantir que os registros no imobilizado sejam contabilizados conforme determina a ANEEL. Requisitos obrigatórios: Ensino Superior Completo em Administração ou Ciências Contábeis Conhecimento em Manual de Contabilidade do Setor Elétrico, Manual de Contabilidade Patrimonial do Setor Elétrico, CAPEX e OPEX O que temos para você: Vale-alimentação; Vale-refeição; Assistência médica; Assistência odontológica; Participação nos Lucros e Resultados; Previdência privada; Seguro de vida; Wellhub; Convênios com empresas parceiras; Programa de treinamentos e desenvolvimento contínuo. Local de Trabalho: Marechal Floriano/RJ Modelo de Trabalho: 100% presencial * Todas as nossas vagas também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência ;) Há mais de 120 anos, fazemos parte da história e do dia a dia de milhões de pessoas no Rio de Janeiro. Mais do que uma empresa de energia, somos uma potência em movimento. Estamos presentes em 31 municípios, levando energia para mais de 4 milhões de clientes e conectando mais de 11 milhões de vidas com qualidade, confiabilidade e propósito. O que nos move vai além da eletricidade: é a vontade de fazer diferente, de criar soluções sustentáveis, de colocar o cliente no centro e de transformar realidades, sempre com ética, simplicidade, inteligência de dados e, acima de tudo, com gente boa. Nosso compromisso é contribuir para o bem-estar da sociedade e liderar a transformação do sector elétrico com responsabilidade, inovação e eficiência. Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza novas ideias. Onde resultados são reconhecidos, os desafios são grandes e o aprendizado é ainda maior. Acreditamos em pessoas inquietas, que pensam como donas, que buscam sempre o melhor e têm coragem para inovar em um setor em plena evolução. Queremos ser referência em confiança e sustentabilidade até 2029 e sabemos que isso começa pelas pessoas que escolhem crescer com a gente. Na Light, cada talento que chega carrega o potencial de iluminar o futuro. Venha fazer parte dessa história. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Advogado(a) Pleno | Rio de Janeiro
description: A Eneva no Rio de Janeiro quer você no time! #VemSerEneva Se você quer atuar como Advogado(a) Pleno foco em Governança Corporativa, Privacidade e Proteção de Dados, temos um novo desafio para você! Sobre a Eneva A Eneva é a maior operadora privada de gás natural do Brasil, atuando de forma integrada da produção à geração de energia e avançando de maneira consistente na comercialização de gás natural. Em um contexto de crescimento e amadurecimento institucional, a companhia fortalece continuamente suas estruturas de governança, integridade, gestão de riscos e conformidade regulatória, com foco em transparência, sustentabilidade e criação de valor de longo prazo. Sobre a posição Buscamos um(a) advogado(a) pleno(a) para atuar com autonomia e proficiência nas iniciativas de Governança Corporativa, Privacidade e Proteção de Dados da companhia. A posição será referência técnica para áreas de negócio e órgãos de governança, assegurando conformidade legal, alinhamento às melhores práticas de mercado e evolução contínua das políticas e processos corporativos. Terá atuação integrada com as áreas de Riscos, Segurança da Informação, Auditoria, TI e demais áreas de negócio, com foco especial na execução e amadurecimento do programa de Privacidade e Proteção de Dados (LGPD). Principais responsabilidades Governança Corporativa Atuar no suporte a temas de governança corporativa, realizando pesquisas, análises e elaboração de pareceres preliminares, com escalonamento adequado de temas de maior complexidade; Apoiar a uniformização de entendimentos e a aplicação de políticas, diretrizes e padrões de governança, garantindo alinhamento às melhores práticas e à conformidade normativa; Apoiar o funcionamento dos órgãos de governança, elaborando minutas de pautas e atas, além de análises iniciais de aderência das deliberações aos normativos internos; Atuar como ponto focal para coleta e consolidação de informações junto às áreas internas para pautas, relatórios e demandas regulatórias; Atuar na atualização de políticas e diretrizes corporativas, incluindo pesquisas e benchmarkings sobre práticas de governança; Apoiar a identificação de riscos de governança, recomendação de controles mitigadores e acompanhamento de planos de ação em conjunto com áreas de negócio e auditorias; Participar da elaboração e condução de treinamentos e comunicações internas, promovendo a cultura de transparência, integridade e responsabilidade corporativa; Elaborar relatórios, apresentações e indicadores de governança; Apoiar a preparação, atualização e organização de documentos e informações periódicas e eventuais de Companhia Aberta, em conformidade com as exigências da CVM. Privacidade e Proteção de Dados Apoiar a execução do programa de Privacidade e Proteção de Dados, incluindo manutenção do ROPA, definição de bases legais, controles por ciclo de vida do dado e mapeamentos de tratamento; Atuar com autonomia na análise de demandas das áreas de negócio, assegurando aderência à LGPD e às políticas internas; Auxiliar na elaboração e revisão de documentos técnicos, como RIPD/DPIA, LIA, avaliações de transferência internacional, classificação e retenção de dados, alinhados às boas práticas (ISO/IEC 27701/27001, NIST Privacy); Prestar suporte consultivo em temas de privacidade, com preparação de pareceres preliminares e alinhamento de entendimentos internos; Apoiar a revisão e negociação de cláusulas contratuais relacionadas à proteção de dados (controlador–operador, co-controladoria e transferência internacional); Atuar no suporte à gestão de incidentes de dados pessoais, em conjunto com Segurança da Informação, Jurídico e Comunicação; Contribuir para iniciativas de privacy by design, avaliando novos produtos, serviços e mudanças de processos; Apoiar avaliações de risco de privacidade em fornecedores, parceiros e projetos; Participar da elaboração e execução de treinamentos, materiais educativos e comunicações internas sobre privacidade; Monitorar atualizações da ANPD, jurisprudência e tendências regulatórias, analisando impactos e propondo ajustes internos; Consolidar indicadores, evidências e informações para relatórios e dashboards do programa de privacidade; Apoiar a identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e automação dos processos de privacidade. Requisitos e qualificações Formação Graduação completa em Direito, com OAB Ativa; Desejável pós-graduação ou especialização em Governança Corporativa, Compliance, Proteção de Dados, Direito Digital ou áreas correlatas. Experiência e conhecimentos Experiência prévia em Governança Corporativa e/ou Privacidade e Proteção de Dados; Conhecimento da LGPD, boas práticas de governança e estruturas de compliance; Vivência em elaboração e revisão de políticas corporativas e documentos regulatórios; Experiência em interação com áreas multidisciplinares e órgãos de governança; Diferencial: atuação em companhias abertas ou ambientes altamente regulados. Competências comportamentais Visão sistêmica e senso crítico; Capacidade analítica e organização; Comunicação clara e habilidade de relacionamento; Autonomia com responsabilidade e foco em conformidade; Perfil colaborativo e orientado a melhoria contínua. Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ. Saiba mais sobre nós em: A Eneva é uma empresa séria e comprometida com a transparência em seus processos seletivos e não solicita qualquer tipo de pagamento durante o processo de seleção. Venha fazer parte do nosso time! Todas as nossas vagas são destinadas também a candidatos PcDs. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Sr. Accountant
description: Who we are Portoro is a branded, tech-enabled property management company for premium vacation rental homes in top-tier leisure destinations . We are raising the bar for the $100+ billion growing STR industry. What we are looking for The Senior Accountant will play a pivotal role in ensuring accurate financial reporting, compliance, and supporting the overall financial health of the organization. This role will report to the CFO and collaborate closely with the global finance team, requiring strong communication skills in English and familiarity with international accounting standards. What you'll do Manage the end-to-end process for bill payments and ensure accurate recording and tracking of expenses. Ensure the accurate recognition of revenue in compliance with company policies and international accounting standards. Prepare and analyze financial reports, offering actionable insights and recommendations to support business decisions. Work with enterprise-level ERP systems to maintain and improve financial operations and reporting. Ensure compliance with US accounting regulations and standards, including tax filings and other financial reports as needed. Work closely with internal teams and external auditors to support audits, budgeting, forecasting, and ad-hoc financial analyses. What you'll bring 3+ years of experience in accounting, with exposure to various areas such as AP, revenue recognition, and financial reporting. Experience with enterprise-level accounting ERP systems (Sage preferred; NetSuite or Oracle also acceptable). Knowledge of US accounting standards, with international English experience and the ability to work within a global team. Strong understanding of the monthly close process and ability to manage diverse accounting functions. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or equivalent certification preferred. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other accounting software. Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken. Beyond the paycheck As an early employee, you will be a critical part of our core team and influence the direction of the company. We offer competitive compensation, early-stage stock options, a full suite of benefits, unlimited PTO, and we will invest in your career development. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Productivity Finance Specialist
description: Would you like to help improve project margin performance and recover value across the project lifecycle? Would you like to move beyond periodic reporting and play a direct role in business performance? Be part of a team that keeps moving! This role sits within the Global FPS (Flexible Pipe Systems) Productivity team and focuses on sustainably improving project margins, recovering lost value and supporting better business decisions. It is a hands‑on finance role for someone who wants to combine strong financial discipline with operational understanding, working closely with project, commercial, and functional teams to turn insight into action. Partner with the best As the Productivity Finance Specialist , you will partner closely with productivity, finance, project, and operational stakeholders to strengthen project margin reviews, identify recurring sources of margin leakage, and support recovery actions. You will connect productivity initiatives to project financial performance, improve confidence in reported benefits and help create a clearer, more trusted view of project financials. As the Productivity Finance Specialist, you will be responsible for: Partnering with the Productivity team, project teams, and finance colleagues to support project margin reviews (PMR) and margin improvement actions. Analysing project financial performance to identify margin leakage, recovery opportunities, recurring loss patterns, and improvement themes across the project lifecycle. Linking productivity initiatives to project financial outcomes, helping the business understand where actions are driving measurable improvement, where value is at risk, and where expected benefits are not yet visible in the numbers. Strengthening productivity governance by aligning baselines, assumptions, reporting logic, benefit tracking, and reconciliation to project financials, helping create one clear and trusted view of performance. Working with commercial, sourcing, engineering, manufacturing, and project stakeholders to understand root causes and translate findings into practical actions. Owning and developing the FPS product costing tool, ensuring it provides reliable costing insight for decision‑making, while leading requirements, testing, adoption, and transition planning for more modern costing solutions. Supporting ad‑hoc analysis for senior leaders on margin performance, risk areas, recovery actions, and emerging trends. Using data, dashboards, and digital tools where useful to improve the speed, visibility, and consistency of financial insight. Fuel your passion To be successful in this role, you will: Have a strong finance foundation, with relevant experience in FP&A, project finance, commercial finance, operations finance, or business partnering. Be comfortable moving beyond reporting into a more operational, problem‑solving role with direct business impact. Have strong analytical capability and the ability to translate financial performance into clear business actions. Be confident challenging data inconsistencies, aligning stakeholders around common definitions, and improving trust in the numbers. Be able to challenge constructively, influence non‑finance stakeholders, and work effectively across functions. Have strong communication skills and the confidence to engage with project, operational, commercial, and finance leaders. Be comfortable working in an environment where processes, tools, and visibility are still developing, while helping bring more structure and consistency over time. Be confident using Excel and financial systems; exposure to Power BI or data visualisation would be useful. Desired characteristics Have experience in project‑based, manufacturing, engineering, industrial, or operational environments. Have experience supporting project financial reviews, or structured margin analysis. Have exposure to productivity, cost‑out, value improvement, or recovery programmes. Have experience reconciling multiple financial views or helping establish common reporting standards across teams. Have experience working with performance dashboards or visual reporting tools. Be a qualified or part‑qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent), or bring comparable finance experience with strong commercial credibility. Have interest in using data and digital tools to improve decision making and business visibility. Have a curious, pragmatic, and resilient approach, with a strong sense of ownership and a focus on measurable outcomes. Work in a way that works for you We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following working patterns: Monday to Friday, 7:00 am to 4:00 pm – On‑site RETIC (Fundão/RJ). Working with us Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We are better when our employees are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health, well‑being and development of our workforce and grow leaders at all levels. Working for you Contemporary work‑life balance policies and wellbeing programs. Comprehensive private medical care options. Life insurance and disability coverage. Tailored financial programs. Additional elected or voluntary benefits. The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Project Management Specialist – Operat Leadership. About Us We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet. Join Us Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward. Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. title: Head of Finance
description: Head of Finance Department: Administration Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION Under the joint responsibility of the FIFA27 Executive Director Administration and the FIFA Finance Division, the Head of Finance will contribute to the development of the financial strategy, will oversee the financial operations of the local entity and will manage the dedicated finance team. The finance department of the entities will include the following functions: Accounting, Controlling, Treasury, Tax and Insurance. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Structuring phase: To consolidate the small Finance Team consisting of Accounting, Taxes and Controlling To finalize the implementation of FIFA Financial tools. To be responsible for reviewing the necessary policies and procedures implemented by the company, in consideration of FIFA’s requirements and local law. To be responsible of implementing those policies and procedures in daily activities, to ensure compliance and appropriate financial transparency and governance. Planning & Operating Phase: To lead all aspects of the finance function of the FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil: Accounting, Taxes, Controlling, Treasury and Insurance To act as business partner to all functions guiding well-informed decision making and managing the financial risks. To align and coordinate with all requirements relating to FIFA Finance in overall (e.g. consolidation, budgeting and reporting requirements). To establish and develop relations with senior management and external partners and stakeholders. To act in a coordinated way with other departments within the entities and within FIFA to ensure smooth business operations. To analyse and review company cash flow, expenditures and revenues. To participate in financial standards setting and in Forecast process. To support FIFA in the overall financial planning of the tournament. To prepare financial reporting as required by FIFA and the entity’s management. To produce error‑free accounting and tax reports and present their results. To oversee tax audits, tax returns and federal and state tax returns. To ensure compliance with IFRS and FIFA Accounting principles. To provide necessary support for internal customers and external auditors. To seek ways to improve upon accounting and tax processes and procedures. To ensure the efficient implementation of the insurance coverage according to FIFA requirements. To assist the FIFA27 Executive Director Administration and the FIFA Finance Division on special requests. To manage, supervise and motivate the Finance team and to provide effective guidance and leadership. When necessary to contribute to the daily financial tasks. YOUR PROFILE Higher business education, specialized in Finance or Accounting (university degree or equal education) Minimum of 10 years’ experience in Finance/tax at senior level including 5 years of proven experience in a managing financial function preferably in an event organisation (organising major sport events or other similar projects) In‑depth understanding of local GAAP Previous experience within a finance position in Brazil is mandatory. Good computer knowledge (user), especially MS Excel and SAP Excellent leadership and team‑management skills High ability of lateral thinking Taking initiative Identification with FIFA Very good analytical skills Persistence, quality mentality Forward‑looking mind‑set with strong results‑orientation Flexibility and open‑mindedness Ability to work under pressure and endurance Very high sense of responsibility Strong and transparent communication skills Ability to engage with staff at all levels of the organisation and exercise sound judgement. Reliability with a strong sense for cooperation/teamwork Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written) Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: MÉDICO DO TRABALHO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description: Descrição da vaga Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Realizar atendimento a exames admissionais, demissionais, periódicos, avaliação médica, retorno ao trabalho, mudança de função, encaminhamento ao INSS ou a médicos especialistas. Orientar restrições e recomendações conforme necessidade de cada caso. Realizar avaliações de atestados médicos, acidentes de trabalho e outras conforme a necessidade da Instituição. Requisitos e qualificações Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina. Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Medicina do Trabalho. Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe. Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico do Trabalho. Informações adicionais Local de trabalho: Santa Cruz - RJ; Escala de trabalho: 20 horas semanais; Horário: A combinar. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Venda Consultiva: Domínio de técnicas de negociação complexas e foco em fechamento de parcerias de valor. Resiliência e Adaptabilidade: Conforto em ambientes de alta pressão, mudanças rápidas e metas agressivas. Ferramentas de Gestão: Domínio de Excel (análise de dados), Salesforce (ou CRM correlato) e PowerPoint (apresentações executivas). Formação Acadêmica: Graduação completa em Administração, Gestão Comercial, Economia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas. Experiência: Sólida trajetória em liderança de times comerciais externos e vendas de serviços (B2B). Mobilidade: Disponibilidade para viagens e CNH categoria B ativa. Gestão de Projetos: Experiência comprovada na construção e execução de planos táticos de vendas. Data Driven: Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados (ex: Power BI ou Tableau). Inteligência Artificial e Inovação: Domínio de ferramentas e metodologias de Inteligência Artificial Generativa para otimização de processos, análise preditiva de tendências de mercado e ganho de eficiência. Direitos e Diversidade No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar Inovação e atingir Resultados incríveis, por isso, não fazemos distinção para candidatos com deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar e estética. English is the company’s working language but (Brazilian) Portuguese is required in the local context. Key Responsibilities Support the origination, assessment, structuring and execution of investment transactions in Brazil. Perform detailed financial analysis, credit analysis, financial modeling and risk assessment of potential investments and counterparties. Build and maintain investment models, including DCF, IRR, scenario and sensitivity analyses. Support on‑ and off‑site due diligence processes, including the organization of due diligence exercises, financial analysis and preparation of investment proposals and investment committee materials. Develop analyses on operating environments, sectors and counterparties as part of the investment origination, execution and monitoring cycles. Translate key business and operational drivers into robust underwriting assumptions and investment cases. Support transaction execution processes in coordination with internal stakeholders and external advisors. Monitor existing investments based on financial reports, portfolio performance, covenant compliance and client interactions. Support relationship management activities, including the processing of covenant waivers, amendments and ad‑hoc client requests, where applicable. Prepare internal and external reporting related to investments, portfolio performance and market developments. Conduct market and sector research to support investment decision‑making processes. What we expect Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, engineering, mathematics, or a related field. Master’s degree in finance or professional qualifications (e.g., CFA) are a plus. 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in investment management, structured finance, corporate finance, private equity, investment banking, capital markets, credit analysis or related areas. Strong experience in financial modeling, underwriting and investment analysis. Experience supporting or executing investment transactions, due diligence processes and transaction structuring activities. Solid understanding of corporate investments, financial statements analysis and risk assessment methodologies. Experience in carbon credit related fields would be highly advantageous. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. We value diversity and inclusion and highly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including underrepresented groups. Strong alignment with Finance in Motion’s mission and impact‑driven investment approach. Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deliver high‑quality outputs under tight deadlines. What you can expect An agile, widely diverse international working environment with employees of 68 nationalities that is keenly interested in making a positive difference through their work and who share a collaborative, can‑do spirit. A company that is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive, contribute, and grow. A job that allows you to fully utilize and expand your skills within an innovative, hands‑on company culture. A purpose‑driven, performance‑oriented company that rewards above‑average results. An organization dedicated to providing effective training and upskilling to its employees. A company that offers a flexible and amicable work environment, placing a high value on work‑life balance. We, a team of over 300 dedicated professionals across 16 regional offices worldwide, are committed to advancing sustainable development through pioneering finance solutions. If you relish tackling complex challenges hands‑on and crave an adaptable and motivating work environment, we’re eager to connect with you. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Técnico de Mecânica Industrial
description: Venha fazer parte da Silimed! title: Consulting SAP Security Consultant Professional Multiple Cities
description: A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long‑term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. In this role, you'll work in one of our IBM Consulting Client Innovation Centers (Delivery Centers), where we deliver deep technical and industry expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients around the world. Our delivery centers offer our clients locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology. Your role and responsibilities The primary objective is to secure SAP landscapes and ensure compliance with regulations and standards. This involves: Protecting sensitive business data (financial, HR, supply chain). Preventing unauthorized access and fraud. Ensuring governance, risk, and compliance (GRC). Supporting audits and regulatory requirements (e.g., SOX, GDPR, LGPD). Responsible for designing and maintaining secure SAP environments: User Access Management. Create, modify, and deprovision user accounts. Implement role‑based access control (RBAC). Enforce Segregation of Duties (SoD). Authorization Design. Define roles and profiles aligned with business functions. Minimize excessive privileges (principle of least privilege). Authentication & Identity Controls. Integrate SAP with identity providers (SSO, MFA). Required education Bachelor's Degree Preferred education Bachelor's Degree Required technical and professional expertise Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Strong understanding of: Segregation of Duties (SoD) principles. Risk identification and mitigation strategies. Internal controls frameworks (e.g., SOX, COSO). Access risk analysis and remediation. Control design, testing, and documentation. Regulatory & Data Privacy Knowledge Familiarity with regulations such as: GDPR / LGPD (data privacy). ISO 27001 / NIST frameworks. Translate regulatory requirements into SAP controls. Support audit readiness and compliance reporting. Stakeholder & Communication Skills Ability to collaborate with: Translating technical risks into business impact. Writing policies, procedures, and audit documentation. Leading access reviews and governance meetings. Risk Management & Analytical Thinking Ability to: Prioritize vulnerabilities based on impact. Balance security vs. usability/business needs. Preferred technical and professional experience SAP Security Implementation Knowledge (Preferred): Experience with implementing security controls and solutions to protect SAP systems from cyber threats, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and standards, would be beneficial. Compliance Advisory Expertise: Familiarity with advising clients on SAP cybersecurity and compliance best practices, identifying areas for improvement and providing recommendations for remediation, is advantageous. Security Solution Validation Skills: Knowledge of testing and validating the effectiveness of security controls and solutions implemented in SAP environments would be an asset. All our positions are eligible for people with disabilities PwD or rehabilitated. IBM is proud to be an equal‑opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, pregnancy, disability, neurodivergence, age, or other characteristics protected by the applicable law. IBM is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Translating growth and brand strategy into platform architecture , turning audience, campaign and website needs into clear architectural choices and explicit trade‑offs with a long‑term view. Operating in high‑visibility, cross‑impact areas , where platform decisions directly affect Nubank’s growth, brand presence and audience activation across BR, MX, CO and future geos. Framing ambiguous problems into clear options , and driving alignment through well‑structured communication (technical docs, RFCs, design sessions and presentations). Ability to work end‑to‑end across a multi‑product stack , partnering with several squads to make sure platforms interoperate as a coherent ecosystem. Proven track record connecting product strategy and platform design , turning growth and brand objectives into concrete architectural choices for audiences, campaign orchestration and website capabilities. Strong technical leadership skills : setting architectural direction, driving design reviews, evolving engineering standards and mentoring senior engineers and tech leaders. Experience with experimentation and data‑driven decision making , and with designing systems that are observable, instrumented and easy to reason about. Demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments , collaborating with Product, Data, Design, Marketing and other platform teams to align priorities and manage dependencies. Comfort operating in high‑visibility, cross‑impact domains , where platform decisions have direct effect on growth and brand outcomes. High tolerance for ambiguity , with the ability to frame complex problems into clear options and drive alignment through structured written and verbal communication. Nice to have Background in growth, martech or CRM platforms . Experience in multi‑country or multi‑brand environments . Previous work on customer data platforms, journey orchestration or experimentation platforms . description: Responsabilidades e atribuições Liderar, desenvolver e orientar a equipe de Supervisores de Qualidade da região, assegurando o cumprimento das metas e a padronização das rotinas de campo. Analisar resultados, elaborar relatórios gerenciais e reportar à liderança a evolução dos indicadores e o andamento dos projetos sob sua responsabilidade. Promover a cultura de qualidade e segurança de alimentos, disseminando padrões, capacitando a equipe e reforçando o compromisso da companhia com a qualidade da matéria-prima. Formação superior completa em Medicina Veterinária, Zootecnia, Engenharia Agronômica ou áreas correlatas. Experiência consolidada em qualidade do leite, captação leiteira ou áreas correlatas do segmento de laticínios e alimentos. Vivência em gestão de equipes ou em condução de projetos e processos relacionados à qualidade, com perfil de liderança e articulação. Conhecimento dos parâmetros e indicadores de qualidade do leite cru (CCS, CPP/CBT, composição e demais análises) e dos fatores que impactam esses resultados no campo. Conhecimento da legislação aplicável à qualidade e captação do leite, com destaque para as Instruções Normativas do MAPA. Disponibilidade para residir e atuar em Três Rios/RJ, com disponibilidade para viagens e atuação em campo junto aos produtores e às unidades da região. Habilitação categoria B e disponibilidade para conduzir veículo nas rotinas de campo. Diferenciais Vivência na condução de projetos de fomento e melhoria da qualidade do leite em parceria com Sebrae, Senar ou instituições similares. Conhecimento de sistemas de gestão da qualidade, captação e precificação utilizados no segmento leiteiro. Vivência em relacionamento institucional com órgãos de defesa sanitária e entidades reguladoras. title: Head of Customer Proposition
description: About the Role We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day. Not remote: This is a hybrid role in São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. We are looking for a commercially driven and customer-centric Head of Customer Proposition to join our Brazil team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the local 360° customer proposition strategy across our core product verticals, including Sports, Gaming and Social . As a senior leader within the Brazil Commercial organisation, you will oversee the ideation, development and execution of market-leading propositions that attract, engage, reward and retain customers throughout their lifecycle. You will lead a team of local product vertical experts and work cross-functionally to ensure our customer experiences are locally relevant, insight-led and commercially impactful. Working closely with the Commercial Director, Brazil, and wider regional and global stakeholders, you will shape and execute the local proposition strategy aligned to broader regional objectives, ensuring we deliver standout experiences that strengthen customer loyalty, increase engagement and drive sustainable growth in the Brazilian market. This role requires a deep understanding of the Brazilian betting and gaming landscape, strong commercial acumen, and a passion for delivering best-in-class customer experiences through innovation, personalisation and operational excellence. What You’ll Be Doing Define and lead the Brazil customer proposition strategy across Sports, Gaming and Social verticals, aligned to wider regional and global business objectives. Develop and execute a local proposition roadmap that enhances customer engagement, retention, cross-sell and lifetime value. Lead and develop a high-performing team of vertical managers/leads, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability and customer obsession. Partner with senior commercial and marketing stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities, market trends and competitive advantages within the Brazilian market. Customer Lifecycle, Retention & Engagement Collaborate with CRM to oversee the development and optimisation of lifecycle and customer journeys across acquisition, onboarding, retention, reactivation and higher-value segments. Ensure generosity and customer value are delivered effectively throughout key customer moments and major sporting and entertainment events. Drive advanced segmentation and personalisation strategies to create relevant, timely, and differentiated customer experiences. Collaborate with CRM and Performance teams to build sophisticated, data-led communication plans that improve engagement and long-term retention. Commercial Performance & Optimisation Own the proposition bonus and promotional investment strategy across all verticals, ensuring strong budget governance, efficiency and ROI. Monitor and optimise proposition performance against key commercial KPIs including retention, conversion, cross-sell, active days, engagement and customer value. Lead the Test & Learn roadmap for Brazil, identifying and prioritising experiments that improve customer and commercial outcomes. Use customer insights, analytics, and market intelligence to continuously evolve proposition performance and identify new growth opportunities. Product & Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Product, GTM, Commercial, BI, CRM, Performance Marketing, Operations and Brand teams to ensure seamless proposition delivery and execution. Ensure alignment between local commercial priorities and the central Sports, Gaming and Social product roadmaps. Support acquisition strategies by optimising propositions and promotional mechanics to improve marketing efficiency and conversion performance. Collaborate with Analytics and Performance teams to build best-in-class reporting frameworks and performance dashboards to inform strategic decision-making. Market & Regulatory Excellence Maintain a strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory landscape and ensure all proposition activity complies with local requirements and responsible gaming standards. Stay informed on competitor activity, customer behaviours and emerging market trends to ensure propositions remain innovative and market-leading. Champion a customer-first approach across all proposition initiatives and touchpoints. What We’re Looking For Significant experience in a senior proposition or commercial leadership role, ideally within the iGaming, sports betting or digital e-commerce/fintech space. Strong knowledge of the Brazilian betting, gaming, and digital consumer landscape. Proven experience building and executing customer proposition and retention strategies across multiple verticals. Strong commercial and analytical acumen with experience managing promotional budgets and performance KPIs. Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders. Proven track record of managing and developing high-potential teams and individuals. This role involves direct role management responsibility. Deep understanding of customer lifecycle management, segmentation, personalisation, cross-sell and engagement strategies. Experience leading Test & Learn initiatives and using data-driven insights to optimise customer and commercial performance. Ability to oversee complex cross-functional initiatives/projects to completion and deliver successful business outcomes Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Passion for innovation, customer experience, and delivering market-leading propositions. Preferred Experience Experience across Sportsbook, Casino/Gaming and Social or community-led products. Familiarity with onsite/crm tools, bonus engines, and customer analytics tools. Experience operating within a fast-paced, high-growth, and regulated environment. Understanding of responsible gaming principles and local compliance requirements in Brazil. About Super We are a global technology group, dedicated to building the future of entertainment and fan-centric experiences. With commercial markets in Brazil, Belgium, Poland, Romania, Greece and Serbia, and a network of offices across Spain, Croatia, Malta, Gibraltar, the Netherlands and the UK, we are a truly international organization. Our purpose at Super has evolved from sports and betting into creating the platform that stretches into the wider world of technology-driven entertainment. With a growing and diverse team of more than 5,000 people, we create immersive, responsible, and personalised experiences for millions of customers worldwide. Shaping the Future of Play Everything we do at Super is rooted in doing what is right: for customers, for each other, and for our long-term vision. Our Culture Manifesto is our North Star. It captures our purpose, mission, and the six core beliefs that shape how we think, make decisions, and act every day. Want to explore our culture in more detail? Visit our careers page: super.xyz/careers Super is committed to the highest standards of compliance, safety, and responsibility. As such, we are active members of the International Betting Integrity Association (IBIA) and the European Gaming & Betting Association (EGBA). At Super, we operate as a high-performing team. We hire and grow talent based on ability and potential, regardless of background and identity because we know diverse perspectives, drive better performance. This position is based in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. In your daily routine, you will be led 100% in English. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO: A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. Neste contexto a AVSI irá operacionalizar um projeto no Municipio do Rio de Janeiro e em algumas áreas da baixada fluminense, com objetivo de mobilização social, organização comunitária e atividades correlatas, visando ao engajamento e a integração das comunidades nos municípios de atuação da empresa que são localizados no estado do Rio de Janeiro, com predominância nas regiões metropolitanas e capital. O foco está na sensibilização sobre as atividades sociais da empresa através de momentos educativos, alinhando transparência, inclusão e bem-estar da população atendida. Poderão ser promovidos eventos, com objetivo de ativar outros parceiros, para consolidar a relação de confiança entre a empresa e a população local, criando marketing positivo e desenvolvimento das comunidades. DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO: O Gerente de Projeto será responsável pela gestão integral do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento das diretrizes contratuais e dos procedimentos da AVSI. Essa função abrange a coordenação completa do ciclo do projeto, integrando aspectos gerenciais e administrativos, com responsabilidade final pelo planejamento e execução das atividades, gerenciamento da equipe dedicada, mobilização das comunidades, suporte técnico e administrativo, além do desenvolvimento de metodologias de controle e logística para assegurar a execução eficiente e os resultados esperados. Gerenciar o orçamento do programa, assegurando o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, acompanhando a execução orçamentária, controlando despesas, e garantindo o cumprimento das regras e diretrizes estabelecidas pelo contrato e pelos procedimentos da AVSI. Organizar as atividades do projeto nos seus aspectos operacionais e administrativos, apresentando relatórios ao responsável preposto. Auxiliar na solicitação de compras previstas no Plano de Aquisição aprovado, garantindo a correta descrição de bens e serviços para o setor de aquisições. Selecionar, coordenar, supervisionar, monitorar e avaliar a equipe técnica do programa. Aplicar rigorosamente os procedimentos e regras estabelecidos nos manuais da AVSI. Manter atualizado o arquivo de documentos no sistema de PATRIMONIALIZAÇÃO da AVSI. Enviar periodicamente ao setor de Comunicação materiais sobre o projeto para publicação. Contribuir para a elaboração de documentos descritivos necessários à prestação de contas do projeto. Representar a AVSI no diálogo e na relação técnica com a equipe da contratante. Realizar missões e atividades em outros territórios ou escritórios da AVSI no Brasil, quando necessário. Contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios internos destinados ao cliente. Participar de reuniões e conferências periódicas, sempre que solicitado. Desenvolver o programa de acordo com as especificações técnicas do contrato, respeitando prazos, escopo e conteúdos previamente estabelecidos. Executar os processos necessários para a plena realização das atividades previstas no programa. Gerenciar a execução técnica das atividades, assegurando que os conteúdos, metodologias, estruturas e equipamentos sejam aplicados de maneira favorável ao alcance dos objetivos propostos. Coordenar a mobilização e promover o diálogo para engajamento do público-alvo. Articular parcerias com outras organizações para fortalecer ações do programa. Organizar a logística de campo, elaborando documentos comprobatórios que evidenciem o desenvolvimento das atividades realizadas. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internas. title: Mechanical & Rotating Engineer
description: Airswift is seeking a Mechanical and Rotating Equipment Engineer (Onshore) to work in Rio de Janeiro in a permanent position with an Oil and Gas Company. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Act as a Technical Authority (Integrity) to evaluate and respond to Management of Change (MOC) and Technical Assistance (TA) requests. Lead Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA/RCA) and develop reliability and maintenance strategies for rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, turbines, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems), ensuring compliance with company standards and international codes, increasing MTBF and reducing downtime. Evaluate, respond to, and approve MOC/TA requests, technical changes, and deviations, ensuring compliance with company standards and applicable regulations (API/ASME/ISO/ABNT). Issue Technical Notes and Guidelines as a recognized subject matter expert, standardizing practices and lessons learned. Ensure complete documentation, traceability, and clear communication with onshore/offshore stakeholders. Monitor the performance of rotating equipment using PDM/CBM techniques: vibration analysis, thermography, and oil analysis (including ferrography and spectroscopy) for early anomaly detection. Supervise and execute Product/Performance Data Monitoring (PDM) services, recommending corrective and preventive actions. Develop and implement condition-based maintenance (CBM) programs to optimize availability and reduce downtime. Develop and implement reliability and maintenance (RCM) strategies, with preventive/predictive plans to improve MTBF and lifecycle cost. Perform diagnostics on pumps, centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems; recommend corrective actions. Identify and manage problematic components, conduct disposal plans, and prioritize investments to sustain reliability improvements. Lead the ACR for recurring failures and problems using structured methodologies (5 Whys, Ishikawa, TapRooT, etc.); issue actionable reports and verify the effectiveness of actions. Conduct component failure analyses (seals, bearings, rotors, gears, shafts) and propose design, operational, or maintenance improvements. Provide daily technical support to Operations and Maintenance areas to resolve machine problems, unplanned downtime, and optimize control/operating parameters. Offer guidance for commissioning/start-up, operations, reviews, and updates of controls/monitoring for rotating equipment. Support capital projects by reviewing maintainability and reliability specifications and ensuring correct installation/alignment according to API/AGMA/ISO standards. Support the preparation of Technical Risk Assessments (ART) and contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and systems. JOB QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering. MBA/Postgraduate degree in Reliability, Maintenance, or Asset Management is a plus. Advanced English required. Experience in operation, maintenance, or reliability of rotating equipment in the Oil and Gas sector (offshore/onshore), focusing on centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, pumps, and turbomachinery. Solid knowledge of rotating equipment reliability, RCM, CBM, and PDM services. Hands‑on experience in condition monitoring (vibration, oil analysis, thermography) and fault diagnosis. Proven experience in troubleshooting and field condition monitoring. Solid knowledge of API standards (e.g., 610/617/618/670/682/686), machine design, lubrication, mechanical seals (including dry gas seals). Rotor dynamics, balancing, alignment, and modal analysis. Practical knowledge of international codes and standards (ASME, ANSI, ISO 10816/20816). In‑depth knowledge of rotating equipment: pumps, compressors, dry gas seal systems, and gearboxes. Certification in vibration analysis (e.g., ISO CAT II/III) desirable; certifications in oil analysis/thermography are an advantage. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Captain
description: The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth. Here Is What We Offer Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture Join Howard University and thrive with us! Basic Function The purpose of this position is to assist in the management of the Department of Public Safety (DPS) by providing administrative oversight and assisting in policy development. It may be designated Shift Commander and provide supervision and coordination over the daily operations of assigned personnel in keeping with established goals and objectives of the Department of Public Safety serving the Howard University and Howard University Hospital (HUH). SUPERVISORY Acts in a senior management capacity over other positions; orienting and training others, and assigning and reviewing their work. Accountability Internal contacts include academic and medical executives, administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the University and Hospital. External contacts include parent/guardians, patients, Mayoral Command Post, representatives from local and national Homeland security operations, social service agencies, special police officers, Security Officer’s Management Branch, members of the local criminal justice system to include Metropolitan Police, U.S. Attorney’s Office, Department of Corrections, Youth Services organizations, etc. and the general public. Principal Accountabilities Serves as a Commander over a large section or Division of the Howard University/HUH Department of Public Safety Operation; responsible for all operations in assigned sector on a 24 hour per day basis; administers comprehensive security programs to prevent crimes against persons and property on University Campus and HUH. Provides supervision and oversight over the duties of Deputy Shift Commander in shift operations to ensure that duties involving training and overseeing patrol activities, e.g. directing traffic, controlling crowds; securing facilities are conducted successfully. Works with higher management to develop procedures and directives, rules and regulations for the effective operations of the Department of Public Safety Police force within the guidelines of University, HUH, Federal and Municipal Governments’ laws and statutes. Prepares high level administrative reports, provides statistical data, reviews all incident reports; advises HUH and University management on security issues. Makes comprehensive plans to coordinate special events with the DC Office of Emergency Preparedness, Homeland Security or other federal or municipal agency; takes appropriate actions in response to unforeseen or unexpected incidents; ensures compliance with applicable policy, laws, rules and regulations; maintains emergency plans and makes determination as to when plans should be employed. May manage and coordinate plans and set priorities for fiscal activities of entire Department of Public Safety or may supervise and assist in the preparation of the annual budget for assigned sector; submits recommendations to management for review; may participate in the selection and evaluation process of new employees. Assists in establishing performance metrics consistent with the duties and responsibilities for the Department of Public Safety and HUH. Periodically inspects departments, facilities, equipment and personnel to ensure their safety and compliance with Department of Public Safety policies and procedures. Makes long term projection for labor distribution to ensure that critical areas are covered; provides instruction to immediate subordinates in the proper performance of their duties. May coordinate the acquisition and maintenance of Police equipment; direct the issuance of equipment and ensures accountability for equipment materials and supplies including automobiles, communication equipment, uniforms etc. May confer with management, to review achievements and discuss changes in long and short range goals and objectives; may monitor and plan the training schedule for in-house and outside agencies; maintain expiration roster and prepares license renewal for officers. Responds in person to the most serious incidents when called by subordinates to incidents occurring on University or HUH property; establishes a Field Command Post to supervise and direct police activities; meets with outside law enforcement and regulatory agencies. Assists the Chief and Deputy Chief with various policy, fiscal, budgetary, human resources and other administrative matters as required. May serve in the absence of the Deputy Chief as required. Performs other job-related duties as assigned by the Chief of the Department of Public Safety or other relevant authority. Core Competencies Extensive knowledge of criminal law, including elements of offenses, rules of evidence, laws of arrest, search and seizures, methods of law enforcement, maintenance of public safety and security, and related law enforcement principles. Extensive knowledge of current departmental, municipal and governmental policies and procedural changes relating to security. Ability to demonstrate expertise in hospital safety and security principles and practices in order to effectively assist in the directing of the Hospital’s safety and security programs and activities. Ability to maintain and provide a general source of University, Hospital and community information. General knowledge of computer programs, to include word processing, spreadsheet, database and presentation software. Enhanced skills in the use of firearms and other standard police equipment with the ability to secure a Special Police Officer Commission with firearm authorization from the District of Columbia. Enhanced skills in the use of both oral and written English with the ability to read technical literature, write investigative reports and to express complex cases and relationships orally and written forms. Excellent skill in public and customer relations with the ability to use tact, diplomacy and decorum. Ability to make public presentations, to negotiate and to successfully navigate internal and external politics. Ability to direct others in the investigative process and to provide leadership, training and direction to subordinates. Ability to remain emotionally stable and to display mature judgment and tact in explosive and/or dangerous situations. Ability to work a flexible schedule and be on call during a 24 hour a day, seven days per week timeframe. Ability to establish and maintain harmonious and effective work relations with staff, students, university officials, faculty, other public safety organizations; and the general public. Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in Law Enforcement, Criminal Justice or closely related field and four (4) years of work experience which included three (3) years at a supervisory level or the equivalent combination of eight (8) years combined relevant training and experience. Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description is not be construed as a contract for employment. Compliance Salary Range Disclosure Expected Pay Range: $80,000 to $85,000 #J-18808-Ljbffr
